control_snapshot.bootstrap_note: Manifest and RUN_LIFECYCLE were read first. DESIRED_STATE and reasoning config were then read twice with identical blob/revision tuples before own-state semantics were consumed.

action: Executed exactly one bounded direct-architecture slice: created and exact-read a role-local durable artifact whose existence/content is itself the material outcome, while precommitting an ACTION_COMPLETE falsification control that must remain unresolved when a non-repository external mutation is intrinsically required.

tested_result.reason: The durable role-local evidence/state artifact was directly produced through the Chat-exposed repository write surface and exact-read back; no separate richer-mode, protected, manual-user, or non-repository execution step was used for that outcome class.
tested_result.falsification_reason: If the material target is an independently observable non-repository external mutation, a repository artifact that describes the mutation is not equivalent to the mutation itself.
tested_result.scope_limit: This does not establish parity for intrinsically external actions or all richer-mode outcomes.

assessment.zero_quota_note: No hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package allowance, cloud credit, external API/model credit, or paid compute/storage quota was consumed; repository transport itself may be transiently rate-limited and must be checkpointed/retried only on a later invocation.

architecture_implication.proved: Outcome parity can be direct for the subset of tasks whose material completion criterion is the durable Chat-native evidence/state artifact itself.
architecture_implication.not_proved: Artifact creation cannot substitute for an intrinsically external action merely by recording intent or evidence.
architecture_implication.next_design_move: Add a pre-effect verifier that classifies requested outcomes as ARTIFACT_COMPLETE versus ACTION_COMPLETE and rejects false artifact-parity promotion before any external effect attempt.

allowed_semantic_inputs: role-local artifact created in this slice

remaining_frontier: Test a verifier-guided classifier that distinguishes ARTIFACT_COMPLETE from ACTION_COMPLETE before effect execution.
Keep intrinsically non-repository action outcomes unresolved until a zero-quota, zero-cost Chat-native direct effect architecture is actually proven.
